modules.title: 我吃完飯了，你呢？
modules.title_py: Wǒ chī wán fàn le, nǐ ne?
modules.title_id: I've finished eating — what about you?
modules.scene: Seven in the evening in the dorm kitchen. Your roommate has just come back from class and hasn't eaten yet. You share food, clear the dining table, and plan to watch a film once your homework is done.
can_do: Ask and answer whether someone has eaten/done something (吃過了嗎？／吃完了嗎？)
Tell 'already' (V過2) apart from 'ever' (V過1) when listening
Order your evening activities: finish A, then B (V完…就…／接著…)
modules.exam_link: Routines & housework are a FREQUENT topic in 聽力 Parts 1–2 and 閱讀 Parts 1–2. The polite phrase 吃過了 (a soft way to decline an invitation) is a typical implicature pattern in 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 安妮，你吃過飯了嗎？
lines.py: Ān ní, nǐ chī guò fàn le ma?
lines.id: Annie, have you eaten?

lines.zh: 剛才吃過了。你呢？
lines.py: Gāng cái chī guò le. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: Yes, just now. And you?

lines.zh: 我剛下課，現在才要吃。
lines.py: Wǒ gāng xià kè, xiàn zài cái yào chī.
lines.id: I've just finished class; I'm only about to eat now.

lines.zh: 廚房裡還有一些炒飯，我做得太多了。你吃吧！
lines.py: Chú fáng lǐ hái yǒu yì xiē chǎo fàn, wǒ zuò de tài duō le. Nǐ chī ba!
lines.id: There's still some fried rice in the kitchen — I made too much. Have some!

lines.zh: 太好了！謝謝你！
lines.py: Tài hǎo le! Xiè xie nǐ!
lines.id: Great! Thank you!

lines.zh: 你吃完了嗎？吃完了，碗放在餐桌上，我來洗。
lines.py: Nǐ chī wán le ma? Chī wán le, wǎn fàng zài cān zhuō shàng, wǒ lái xǐ.
lines.id: Finished eating? If so, put the bowl on the dining table and I'll wash it.

lines.zh: 炒飯都吃光了，太好吃了！我自己洗就好。你功課寫完了嗎？
lines.py: Chǎo fàn dōu chī guāng le, tài hǎo chī le! Wǒ zì jǐ xǐ jiù hǎo. Nǐ gōng kè xiě wán le ma?
lines.id: The fried rice is all gone — it was delicious! I'll wash it myself. Have you finished your homework?

lines.zh: 寫完了。明天的考試，我也準備了。
lines.py: Xiě wán le. Míng tiān de kǎo shì, wǒ yě zhǔn bèi le.
lines.id: Yes. I've prepared for tomorrow's exam too.

lines.zh: 那我們接著看電影吧！這部電影很長，十一點才結束。
lines.py: Nà wǒ men jiē zhe kàn diàn yǐng ba! Zhè bù diàn yǐng hěn cháng, shí yī diǎn cái jié shù.
lines.id: Then let's watch a film after this! It's a long film — it won't finish until eleven.

lines.zh: 好啊！看完電影，我就去睡覺。
lines.py: Hǎo a! Kàn wán diàn yǐng, wǒ jiù qù shuì jiào.
lines.id: OK! When it's over, I'm going straight to bed.

lines.zh: 你看過這部電影嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ kàn guò zhè bù diàn yǐng ma?
lines.id: Have you seen this film before?

lines.zh: 看過，去年在印尼看過一次，可是我很想再看一次。
lines.py: Kàn guò, qù nián zài Yìn ní kàn guò yí cì, kě shì wǒ hěn xiǎng zài kàn yí cì.
lines.id: Yes, once last year in Indonesia, but I'd like to see it again.

lines.zh: 你昨天感冒了，今天吃過藥了嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ zuó tiān gǎn mào le, jīn tiān chī guò yào le ma?
lines.id: You had the flu yesterday — have you taken your medicine today?

lines.zh: 吃過了，現在好一點了。
lines.py: Chī guò le, xiàn zài hǎo yì diǎn le.
lines.id: Yes, I'm a bit better now.

tasks.why: 剛才吃過了 = politely declining an invitation because she has already eaten. B = misreading V過2 as V過1 (a reversal). C = misreading the polite phrase. D has no basis in the dialogue.

tasks.question: 這位先生可能會吃什麼？
tasks.why: Still hungry, the cake is 吃光了 → only fruit is left. A: already finished. C: already had dinner. D: she is still hungry.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 我寫（　）作業了，接著要洗澡。
tasks.why: 寫完 = to finish writing. 光 is for something used up (吃光); 結束 is not used as a complement.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 今天晚上，我和室友在宿舍的（1）做飯。我們做了三個菜，（2）就在（3）上吃。菜很好吃，二十分鐘就吃（4）了。吃完以後，室友洗碗，我（5）去寫功課。
tasks.why: (1) a place for cooking → 廚房. (2) finish cooking and then eat right away → 做完. (3) 在餐桌上吃. (4) 吃光了 = all gone. (5) the order of activities → 接著. 看過 doesn't fit any blank.

tasks.instr: Read this notice, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 注意：宿舍的廚房每天早上六點開，晚上十點關。晚上十點以後，廚房已關門，不能做飯。用完廚房，碗和筷子要自己洗乾淨。
tasks.question: 哪一個是對的？
options: 晚上十一點可以在廚房做飯。
tasks.why: Text: 碗和筷子要自己洗乾淨. A and D reverse the meaning (已關門，不能做飯). C mixes up numbers (十點 is the closing time, not the opening time).

grammar.explain: 完 after a verb = the action is complete. 吃了 is just 'have eaten'; 吃完了 stresses 'have finished/it's all gone'. To ask: V完了嗎？ Negative: 沒V完. Often linked to the next activity: V完 + O，就 + V2.

examples.id: I've finished my homework.
When the film's over, I'm going straight to bed.

check.q: Choose the right word: 你的功課寫＿＿了嗎？寫完了，我們就去看電影。

grammar.explain: V過2 + 了 = the action HAS BEEN done (usual when asked 'have you … yet?'). Compare V過1 (learned in Vol.2) = to have EVER experienced: 我看過這部電影 (I've seen this film before). Quick clue: 了 at the end and a context of routine/today → V過2.

examples.id: I've just eaten.
Have you taken your medicine today?
(V過1) I've seen this film before.

core.meaning: to finish, to be over (吃完, 寫完)

core.note: This 義項 = 'used up'. 光 'light' and 'only' are not taught here.

modules.title: 房間又亂又髒！
modules.title_py: Fáng jiān yòu luàn yòu zāng!
modules.title_id: The room's messy and dirty!
modules.scene: Dawen's roommate, Zhiming, complains that the room is a mess. They tidy things up and plan to buy new furniture.
can_do: Make gentle requests with V一下 (看一下、洗一下)
Forbid with 別 (別放在沙發上)
Name furniture: 書架、書桌、櫃子、沙發、衣架
modules.exam_link: The state of the home & furniture appear in 聽力 Part 1 (pictures of rooms) and 閱讀 Parts 1–2 (dorm rules).

lines.zh: 大文，你的房間又亂又髒！
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ de fáng jiān yòu luàn yòu zāng!
lines.id: Dawen, your room is messy and dirty!

lines.zh: 對不起，我最近太忙了。
lines.py: Duì bù qǐ, wǒ zuì jìn tài máng le.
lines.id: Sorry, I've been too busy lately.

lines.zh: 你的書別放在沙發上，放在書架上吧。
lines.py: Nǐ de shū bié fàng zài shā fā shàng, fàng zài shū jià shàng ba.
lines.id: Don't put your books on the sofa — put them on the bookshelf.

lines.zh: 好。書桌上的東西也太多了。
lines.py: Hǎo. Shū zhuō shàng de dōng xi yě tài duō le.
lines.id: OK. There's too much stuff on the desk as well.

lines.zh: 你看一下，衣服別放在椅子上，要掛在衣架上。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn yí xià, yī fú bié fàng zài yǐ zi shàng, yào guà zài yī jià shàng.
lines.id: Look, don't put clothes on the chair — they should go on hangers.

lines.zh: 好，我趕快洗一下衣服。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ gǎn kuài xǐ yí xià yī fú.
lines.id: OK, I'll wash my clothes right away.

lines.zh: 志明，我們的家具太舊了。
lines.py: Zhì míng, wǒ men de jiā jù tài jiù le.
lines.id: Zhiming, our furniture is too old.

lines.zh: 對，這個櫃子壞了。
lines.py: Duì, zhè ge guì zi huài le.
lines.id: Yes, this cupboard is broken.

lines.zh: 我們去看一下新的沙發吧。
lines.py: Wǒ men qù kàn yí xià xīn de shā fā ba.
lines.id: Let's go and look at new sofas.

lines.zh: 好，可是別買太貴的！
lines.py: Hǎo, kě shì bié mǎi tài guì de!
lines.id: OK, but let's not buy one that's too expensive!

grammar.point: V一下 — for a moment / have a go
grammar.explain: 一下 after a verb makes an action sound brief & light, so requests sound more polite: 你看一下 (have a look), 等一下 (wait a moment), 洗一下衣服.

grammar.explain: 別 = don't, the same as 不要 (B05) but shorter and more familiar. With 請 in front it is more polite.

modules.title: 請把碗洗了。
modules.title_py: Qǐng bǎ wǎn xǐ le.
modules.title_id: Please wash the dishes.
modules.scene: Dawen and Zhiming share the housework: washing the dishes, doing the laundry in the machine, and taking out the rubbish from a torn bag.
can_do: Ask for something to be done to an object with 把 (把碗洗了)
Use 把 + V一V for light actions (把衣服洗一洗)
Talk about housework: 垃圾、洗衣機、乾、破、裝
modules.exam_link: 把 sentences are very common in 聽力 Parts 3–4 (instructions & requests) and 閱讀 Part 4 (paragraphs about housework).

lines.zh: 大文，請把碗洗了。
lines.py: Dà wén, qǐng bǎ wǎn xǐ le.
lines.id: Dawen, could you wash the dishes?

lines.zh: 好。你把衣服洗一洗吧，洗衣機在那裡。
lines.py: Hǎo. Nǐ bǎ yī fú xǐ yì xǐ ba, xǐ yī jī zài nà lǐ.
lines.id: OK. You do the laundry — the washing machine's over there.

lines.zh: 昨天的衣服都乾了嗎？
lines.py: Zuó tiān de yī fú dōu gān le ma?

lines.zh: 乾了。我把它們拿進來了。
lines.py: Gān le. Wǒ bǎ tā men ná jìn lái le.
lines.id: Yes. I've already brought them in.

lines.zh: 這個袋子破了，垃圾都掉了！
lines.py: Zhè ge dài zi pò le, lā jī dōu diào le!

lines.zh: 你用別的袋子裝吧。
lines.py: Nǐ yòng bié de dài zi zhuāng ba.

lines.zh: 好。可是這個袋子太小了。
lines.py: Hǎo. Kě shì zhè ge dài zi tài xiǎo le.
lines.id: OK. But this bag is too small.

lines.zh: 我來弄一弄。你把垃圾拿出去吧。
lines.py: Wǒ lái nòng yí nòng. Nǐ bǎ lā jī ná chū qù ba.
lines.id: Let me sort it out. You take the rubbish outside.

grammar.point: 把 O V(一)V — (quickly) do something to O
grammar.explain: 把 moves the object IN FRONT of the verb to stress what is done to it. V一V (洗一洗, 弄一弄) makes the action sound light/brief.

examples.id: You wash the clothes, OK?

grammar.point: 把 O V了 — get O done
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 了
grammar.explain: 把 O V了 stresses that the object gets 'dealt with/finished': 把碗洗了 (get the dishes washed). The verb in a 把 sentence can't stand alone — it needs 了, a result, a direction, etc.

examples.id: Please wash the dishes.

core.meaning: to do; to make; to fix

modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei compare life in the countryside and in the city, and the weather in Taiwan and Indonesia.

lines.zh: 大文，你喜歡住在城市還是鄉下？

lines.id: True. Living in the city centre is convenient, but housing is expensive.

lines.zh: 美美，印尼的鄉下跟臺灣的鄉下很不同。

lines.zh: 怎麼不同？

lines.py: Yìn ní méi yǒu Tái wān zhè me lěng. Tái wān de dōng tiān bǐ Yìn ní lěng de duō.
lines.id: Indonesia isn't as cold as Taiwan. Taiwan's winters are much colder than Indonesia's.

lines.zh: 我也想去印尼過那樣的生活，冬天也不冷！
lines.py: Wǒ yě xiǎng qù Yìn ní guò nà yàng de shēng huó, dōng tiān yě bù lěng!
lines.id: I'd like to go to Indonesia and live like that too — not even cold in winter!

modules.scene: Dawen complains that his monthly money is never enough. He and Meimei talk about monthly spending and shopping habits.
can_do: Express gradual change: 越來越 + adjective

modules.exam_link: 越來越／越…越… are a favourite pattern in 閱讀 Part 5 (essays about money & lifestyle) and 聽力 Part 4.

lines.zh: 大文，你的生活費夠嗎？

lines.zh: 不夠。臺灣的東西越來越貴了！
lines.py: Bú gòu. Tái wān de dōng xi yuè lái yuè guì le!
lines.id: No. Things in Taiwan are getting more and more expensive!

lines.py: Duì. Wǒ yì bān yí ge yuè huā yí wàn kuài.

lines.py: Nǐ kàn wǒ de rì jì: wǒ yuè mǎi yuè duō, qián yuè lái yuè shǎo!

lines.py: Yuè dǐ wǒ měi tiān zhǐ chī mán tou.

can_do: Give polite instructions to a group: 請大家 + VP

modules.exam_link: Announcements by teachers/staff (請大家…) are classic material for 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 3; questions ask what to bring/do.

lines.zh: 大文，今天是陰天，出門別忘了帶傘！
lines.py: Dà wén, jīn tiān shì yīn tiān, chū mén bié wàng le dài sǎn!
lines.id: Dawen, it's cloudy today — don't forget your umbrella when you go out!

lines.zh: 好。你看，外頭已經下雨了。
lines.py: Hǎo. Nǐ kàn, wài tou yǐ jīng xià yǔ le.

lines.py: Nǐ de xié zi dōu shī le! Bié zài zǒu lù le, wǒ men zuò chē ba.

lines.zh: 好。明天會是晴天嗎？

lines.id: Everyone, we're going to the mountains tomorrow — please all bring a raincoat and an umbrella. It's cool in the mountains, so wear warmer clothes.

lines.zh: 老師，如果是晴天呢？
lines.py: Lǎo shī, rú guǒ shì qíng tiān ne?
lines.id: Teacher, what if it's sunny?

lines.zh: 晴天也請帶，山上的天氣常常變。

lines.zh: 請你介紹一下自己。

lines.id: Please introduce yourself.

lines.zh: 我是在雅加達出生的，在台北長大。
lines.py: Wǒ shì zài Yǎ jiā dá chū shēng de, zài Tái běi zhǎng dà.
lines.id: I was born in Jakarta and grew up in Taipei.

lines.zh: 你的母語是什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ de mǔ yǔ shì shén me?
lines.id: What's your mother tongue?

lines.zh: 我的母語是印尼話。我上國小的時候，才來臺灣。
lines.py: Wǒ de mǔ yǔ shì Yìn ní huà. Wǒ shàng guó xiǎo de shí hòu, cái lái Tái wān.
lines.id: My mother tongue is Indonesian. I only came to Taiwan when I was at primary school.

lines.zh: 然後呢？
lines.py: Rán hòu ne?
lines.id: And then?

lines.zh: 然後我在台北上中學，現在是大學生。
lines.py: Rán hòu wǒ zài Tái běi shàng zhōng xué, xiàn zài shì dà xué shēng.
lines.id: Then I went to secondary school in Taipei, and now I'm a university student.

lines.zh: 你今年幾歲？
lines.py: Nǐ jīn nián jǐ suì?
lines.id: How old are you this year?

lines.zh: 二十一歲。
lines.py: Èr shí yī suì.
lines.id: Twenty-one.

lines.zh: 你的住址是什麼？
lines.py: Nǐ de zhù zhǐ shì shén me?
lines.id: What's your address?

lines.zh: 台北市中山路二十號。
lines.py: Tái běi shì Zhōng shān lù èr shí hào.
lines.id: No. 20, Zhongshan Road, Taipei.

lines.zh: 你去過大陸嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ qù guò dà lù ma?
lines.id: Have you been to mainland China?

lines.zh: 去過。那時我年紀很小，才八歲，當時我不會說中文。
lines.py: Qù guò. Nà shí wǒ nián jì hěn xiǎo, cái bā suì, dāng shí wǒ bú huì shuō Zhōng wén.
lines.id: Yes. I was little then, only eight, and at that time I couldn't speak Mandarin yet.

grammar.explain: 然後 links events in sequence in a story. It is often paired with 先 (先…然後…). It is also used to ask for the rest of a story: 然後呢？

check.q: Putting things in order: 'I eat first, then sleep.'

lines.py: Wǒ wài gōng jīn nián bā shí duō suì le.
lines.id: My grandpa is over eighty this year.

lines.py: Yí yàng, dōu shì wǒ bà ba de jiě jie huò shì mèi mei.
lines.id: Yes, they're both my dad's sisters.

lines.zh: 伯父和伯母呢？
lines.py: Bó fù hé bó mǔ ne?
lines.id: What about 伯父 and 伯母?

lines.zh: 伯父是我爸爸的哥哥，伯母是他的太太。過年的時候，我家有好多人！
lines.py: Bó fù shì wǒ bà ba de gē ge, bó mǔ shì tā de tài tai. Guò nián de shí hòu, wǒ jiā yǒu hǎo duō rén!
lines.id: 伯父 is my dad's older brother, and 伯母 is his wife. At Lunar New Year my home is really lively!

grammar.point: 好 + 幾/多/些 + 量 — quite a few

modules.exam_link: Life events (marriage, moving, births) SOMETIMES appear in 聽力 Part 2 and 閱讀 Part 4. 快要…了 matters for the order of events.

lines.zh: 美美，我姊姊快要結婚了！
lines.py: Měi měi, wǒ jiě jie kuài yào jié hūn le!
lines.id: Meimei, my sister's getting married soon!

lines.zh: 真的嗎？什麼時候？
lines.py: Zhēn de ma? Shén me shí hòu?
lines.id: Really? When?

lines.zh: 十二月。三天以後，我們一家人就要回印尼了。
lines.py: Shí èr yuè. Sān tiān yǐ hòu, wǒ men yì jiā rén jiù yào huí Yìn ní le.
lines.id: In December. In three days, my whole family is going back to Indonesia.

lines.zh: 你姊姊的先生帥不帥？
lines.py: Nǐ jiě jie de xiān shēng shuài bú shuài?

lines.zh: 很帥！他叫做小林。他們是大學的同班同學。
lines.py: Hěn shuài! Tā jiào zuò Xiǎo lín. Tā men shì dà xué de tóng bān tóng xué.
lines.id: Handsome! His name is Xiao Lin. They were classmates at university.

lines.zh: 你父母高興嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ fù mǔ gāo xìng ma?
lines.id: Are your parents happy?

lines.zh: 很高興！我父親說：「我的女兒快要結婚了！」我母親哭了。
lines.py: Hěn gāo xìng! Wǒ fù qīn shuō: "Wǒ de nǚ ér kuài yào jié hūn le!" Wǒ mǔ qīn kū le.
lines.id: Really happy! My dad said: 'My daughter's getting married soon!' My mum cried.

lines.zh: 你家有幾口人？
lines.py: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.id: How many people are in your family?

lines.zh: 五口人。我外婆已經是老太太了，她也要來。
lines.py: Wǔ kǒu rén. Wǒ wài pó yǐ jīng shì lǎo tài tài le, tā yě yào lái.
lines.id: Five. My grandmother is very old, and she's coming too.

grammar.point: 就要…了 — (with a time) about to …
grammar.pattern: S + time + 就要 + V + 了
grammar.explain: 就要…了 = about to, and it CAN be preceded by a specific time expression: 三天以後就要回印尼了.

examples.zh: 三天以後，我們就要回印尼了。
examples.id: In three days we're going back to Indonesia.

grammar.explain: 快要…了 = soon (hasn't happened yet). It CANNOT be preceded by a specific time (明天快要… ✗) — use 就要 for that.

examples.id: My sister is getting married soon!
The train's about to leave.

grammar.point: 為了 — for the sake of / in order to

lines.id: Meimei, we've been climbing for two hours — I'm tired.

lines.id: Just a few more steps and we're there. At the top we can take a stroll.

lines.zh: 這裡的人對我們很好，給我們水喝。
lines.py: Zhè lǐ de rén duì wǒ men hěn hǎo, gěi wǒ men shuǐ hē.
lines.id: The people here are nice to us — they gave us water.

lines.zh: 你看，這裡的風景很美，我要拍很多相片！
lines.py: Nǐ kàn, zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng hěn měi, wǒ yào pāi hěn duō xiàng piàn!
lines.id: Look, the view is beautiful — I'm going to take loads of photos!

grammar.point: 被 + (N) + V得 + effect — made … by …
grammar.pattern: S + 被 + N + V + 得 + effect

grammar.explain: 掉 after a verb = something is used up/thrown away/lost through that action: 吃掉 (eaten up), 丟掉 (thrown away), 用掉 (used up).

lines.zh: 我的腿和背都很痛。
lines.py: Wǒ de tuǐ hé bèi dōu hěn tòng.
lines.id: My legs and back hurt.

lines.zh: 你要多運動，身體才會好。
lines.py: Nǐ yào duō yùn dòng, shēn tǐ cái huì hǎo.
lines.id: You have to exercise a lot to be healthy.

lines.zh: 可是我沒有時間。
lines.py: Kě shì wǒ méi yǒu shí jiān.
lines.id: But I don't have time.

lines.zh: 你別一直低頭看手機，對眼睛不好。
lines.py: Nǐ bié yì zhí dī tóu kàn shǒu jī, duì yǎn jīng bù hǎo.
lines.id: Don't keep looking down at your phone — it's bad for your eyes.

lines.zh: 你說得對。聽說多運動的人，身高會比較高。
lines.py: Nǐ shuō de duì. Tīng shuō duō yùn dòng de rén, shēn gāo huì bǐ jiào gāo.
lines.id: You're right. They say people who exercise a lot grow taller.

lines.zh: 我才不相信呢！你看那隻貓，毛很長，每天都不動。
lines.py: Wǒ cái bù xiāng xìn ne! Nǐ kàn nà zhī māo, máo hěn cháng, měi tiān dōu bú dòng.
lines.id: I don't believe that at all! Look at that cat — long fur, and it doesn't move all day.

lines.zh: 它不動也不會死！你要多運動才對。
lines.py: Tā bú dòng yě bú huì sǐ! Nǐ yào duō yùn dòng cái duì.
lines.id: It won't die even if it doesn't move! You're the one who should exercise more.

lines.py: Jiù shì "Yìn ní xué shēng zěn me xué Zhōng wén".

lines.id: Great! You'll definitely succeed. Where's Professor Chen?

lines.zh: 就在那邊。從今天起，我每天看書三個小時。我希望得到教授的幫助，我說了就要做到！
lines.py: Jiù zài nà biān. Cóng jīn tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān kàn shū sān ge xiǎo shí. Wǒ xī wàng dé dào jiào shòu de bāng zhù, wǒ shuō le jiù yào zuò dào!
lines.id: Right over there. From today, I'm reading three hours a day. I hope to get the professor's help — what I say, I have to do!

grammar.point: ABAB reduplication — doing something for a bit
grammar.pattern: AB + AB (休息休息、練習練習)

grammar.pattern: 什麼/誰/哪裡 + 都 + VP

grammar.point: 什麼都…，就是… — everything's …, it's just that …

can_do: Say something is done and ready: V好 (做好了、準備好了)

modules.exam_link: Recipes & cooking steps appear in 閱讀 Parts 3–4; V好 marks a finished step in a sequence.

lines.py: Tài hǎo le, wǒ è huài le!
lines.id: Great, I'm starving!

lines.py: Bú yòng, wǒ pào le yì bēi chá.
lines.id: No need — I've already made some tea.

lines.zh: 豆子也熟了嗎？

lines.id: Are the beans cooked too?

lines.zh: 熟了，正好可以吃。
lines.py: Shú le, zhèng hǎo kě yǐ chī.
lines.id: Yes, they're just right to eat.

grammar.pattern: 連 + the extreme case + 都/也 + (不/沒) + VP

grammar.pattern: S + 不知道 + question clause (no 嗎)

modules.title_id: Eat as much as you like today!
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei eat at an all-you-can-eat buffet; the restaurant is full, and they plan a holiday to have as much fun as they like.

modules.title: 考試的時候可以查資料嗎？
modules.title_py: Kǎo shì de shí hòu kě yǐ chá zī liào ma?
modules.title_id: Can we look things up in the exam?
modules.scene: Dawen asks the teacher about the final exam rules, then chats with Meimei about the campus and his study habits.
can_do: Evaluate something as 'not bad' with 還可以
Say 'still' with 還 (還在讀、還在學校)
Talk about exam rules & the campus: 資料、學生證、選課、校園、讀書
modules.exam_link: Exam rules (allowed/not allowed) are classic material for 閱讀 Parts 1 & 3. 還可以 (not bad) is a neutral evaluation often tested in 聽力 Part 2.

lines.zh: 老師，考試的時候可以查資料嗎？
lines.py: Lǎo shī, kǎo shì de shí hòu kě yǐ chá zī liào ma?
lines.id: Teacher, can we look things up in the exam?

lines.zh: 不可以。你們要帶學生證。
lines.py: Bù kě yǐ. Nǐ men yào dài xué shēng zhèng.
lines.id: No. You have to bring your student ID.

lines.zh: 好。老師，新學期的課我還沒選。
lines.py: Hǎo. Lǎo shī, xīn xué qí de kè wǒ hái méi xuǎn.
lines.id: OK. Teacher, I haven't chosen my courses for the new semester yet.

lines.zh: 你還有時間，星期五以前選就可以。
lines.py: Nǐ hái yǒu shí jiān, xīng qí wǔ yǐ qián xuǎn jiù kě yǐ.
lines.id: There's still time — you can choose them before Friday.

lines.zh: 大文，你覺得我們的校園怎麼樣？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ jué de wǒ men de xiào yuán zěn me yàng?
lines.id: Dawen, what do you think of our campus?

lines.zh: 還可以。我常常在圖書館讀書。
lines.py: Hái kě yǐ. Wǒ cháng cháng zài tú shū guǎn dú shū.
lines.id: Not bad. I often study in the library.

lines.zh: 你還在讀那本歷史書嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ hái zài dú nà běn lì shǐ shū ma?
lines.id: Are you still reading that history book?

lines.zh: 還在讀，快讀完了。
lines.py: Hái zài dú, kuài dú wán le.
lines.id: Yes, I've nearly finished it.

grammar.explain: 還 before a verb = still (the situation continues): 還在讀 (still reading), 還在學校 (still at school), 還有時間 (there's still time). Negative: 還沒 (not yet, C07).

modules.title: 一個小時以內送得到嗎？
modules.title_py: Yí ge xiǎo shí yǐ nèi sòng de dào ma?
modules.title_id: Can it be delivered within an hour?
modules.scene: Dawen orders a bento by phone for delivery; the order that arrives is wrong, but it all works out in the end.
can_do: Express time/area limits: 以內／以外／以上／以下
Turn a phrase into a noun with 的 (我要的是…)
Order delivery & correct an order
modules.exam_link: Time limits (…以內) and correcting orders (我要的是…) appear in 聽力 Parts 3–4; questions often ask what was actually ordered.

lines.zh: 你好，我要一份牛肉便當。
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào yí fèn niú ròu biàn dāng.
lines.id: Hello, I'd like to order a beef bento.

lines.zh: 好。還要別的嗎？
lines.py: Hǎo. Hái yào bié de ma?
lines.id: Sure. Anything else?

lines.zh: 不要了。一個小時以內送得到嗎？
lines.py: Bú yào le. Yí ge xiǎo shí yǐ nèi sòng de dào ma?
lines.id: No. Can it be delivered within an hour?

lines.zh: 送得到，三十分鐘以內就到。
lines.py: Sòng de dào, sān shí fēn zhōng yǐ nèi jiù dào.
lines.id: Yes, it'll be there within thirty minutes.

lines.zh: 先生，這是你要的便當嗎？
lines.py: Xiān shēng, zhè shì nǐ yào de biàn dāng ma?
lines.id: Is this the bento you ordered?

lines.zh: 不對，我要的是牛肉的，這是雞肉的。
lines.py: Bú duì, wǒ yào de shì niú ròu de, zhè shì jī ròu de.
lines.id: No, I ordered beef — this is chicken.

lines.zh: 對不起！我整個下午都很忙。
lines.py: Duì bù qǐ! Wǒ zhěng ge xià wǔ dōu hěn máng.
lines.id: I'm sorry! I've been busy all afternoon.

lines.zh: 沒關係，我正好很餓，雞肉的也可以。
lines.py: Méi guān xi, wǒ zhèng hǎo hěn è, jī ròu de yě kě yǐ.
lines.id: That's OK — I'm hungry anyway, chicken's fine too.

grammar.point: 以 + 上/下/內/外 — above/below/within/outside (a limit)
grammar.pattern: number/place + 以上/以下/以內/以外
grammar.explain: 以 + a position word expresses a limit: 一個小時以內 (within an hour), 台北市以外 (outside Taipei City), 十二歲以上/以下 (over/under 12).

examples.zh: 一個小時以內送得到嗎？
examples.id: Can it be delivered within an hour?

examples.zh: 台北市以外，要兩個小時。
examples.id: Outside Taipei, it takes two hours.

grammar.explain: A verb phrase + 的 can stand as a noun: 我要的 (what I want), 你說的 (what you said). Often in the pattern 我要的是… to correct something.

examples.id: What I ordered is beef.
Is this the bento you ordered?
